study: PSB - Policy Structural Binding: one final narrow architectural cycle after PHV1
preregistered_utc_rule: frozen before the first causal inference request; the runner freeze phase machine-verifies this file hash and refuses on any post-freeze edit

context.phv1_status: PHV1 (59/80 = 73.75% prospective) is DEVELOPMENT EVIDENCE from this point on; it may inform hypothesis, taxonomy and architecture design, and may never serve as confirmatory data for the PSB candidate
context.phv1_failure_profile: relation 9/21, multi_axis 6/21, negation_polarity 2, scope_shape 2, modality 1, representation_gap 1; invented explicit permission 8/80 = 10% (all eight are condition-dropping under exceptive constructions: the IF gate was folded into a UNLESS relation while the permission marker was textually present)

hypotheses.H_struct: Current H0 generalizes poorly not because local semantic atoms are universally unreliable, but because the flat single-structure representation fails to preserve attachment relations (which condition, exception, actor, modality, qualifier or provenance binds to which regulated content) under natural-language complexity. Falsifiable prediction: H1 (explicit typed attachment graph + deterministic compilation, same model, same atom contract) raises behavioral case correctness by >= 10 pp over H0 on the causal benchmark AND achieves pooled binding micro-F1 >= 0.85 AND regresses on at most 5% of H0-correct cases.
hypotheses.H_perm: Explicit PERMISSION should only survive compilation when positively licensed by the policy text. Falsifiable prediction: H2 (H1 compilation + frozen positive-evidence permission gate applied to the SAME single parse) has invented-permission case rate <= 2%, permission clause precision >= 95%, and behavioral accuracy >= H1.

arms.H0: frozen current H0, byte-identical (PARSE_TASK, REPAIR_TASK, STRUCTURE_SCHEMA, CONFIG imported from scripts/evaluate_vnext_c_alr_reimpl.py; freeze phase machine-verifies continuity against the sealed PHV1 freeze)
arms.H1: H0-class semantic extraction (same model, same provider, same atom_catalog contract) into an explicit typed attachment GRAPH + deterministic compilation to a per-clause behavioral program set; NO permission gate
arms.H2: H1 with the frozen positive-evidence permission gate applied deterministically at compilation time to the SAME single H1 parse (one PSB request per case; H1 and H2 are two compilations of one prediction, so the gate effect is causally isolated from extraction variance)

prohibitions: no C-ALR mutation verifier, challenger, judge, multi-program Phi, self-consistency or any LLM-based adjudication anywhere in this cycle
no model or provider switch (bai / qwen3.8-flash exactly as frozen in CONFIG); model-capacity experiments are out of scope
no whole-policy alternatives: exactly one primary structural graph per case; local genuine ambiguity is representable locally but multiple complete programs are never generated
the permission gate must be formulated by linguistic class (frozen marker list below); adding exact string rules observed in benchmark failures is forbidden
no semantic changes after the first causal inference; only preregistered transport-level fixes are permitted (none anticipated)
PHV1, V4, V5 and the causal benchmark are development data and are never used as confirmatory cases for the PSB candidate
failure audit only after seal + score; deterministic typed-field diffs only, no LLM judge
no Policy V8/V9/V10: this is the last standalone Policy architecture experiment; after it, STOP and integrate regardless of outcome

causal_benchmark.freshness: new texts, fresh domains, fresh entities, fresh syntax, fresh clause orderings, fresh surface modality; not lexical rewrites of PHV1 failures; machine-checked: zero shared word 8-grams with every V4, V5 and PHV1 policy text; zero internal duplicate texts
causal_benchmark.worlds: deterministic combined-surface generation over the union of gold program surfaces (target/condition/exception fact patterns crossed), each world carrying the composed verdict of the admissible gold set; per-case machine check that the cohort-defining misbinding (condition<->exception swap, gate moved between sibling clauses, modality or actor swap between clauses, strength flip) changes composed verdicts on at least one frozen world
causal_benchmark.envelope: per regulated clause: one modality, at most one plain condition node, at most one temporal (PRECEDES/FOLLOWS) condition node, at most one exception node, at most one actor, at most one qualifier of each kind; REQUIREMENT clauses never combine a condition node with an exception node (same envelope the V4/V5/PHV1 gold space already enforced); one case in the permission cohort has an empty gold program set (text regulates nothing)

node_types.REGULATED: fields: atoms (>=1 catalog atoms regulated TOGETHER; separate nodes = regulated separately)
node_types.CONDITION: fields: literals (catalog atoms, '!' prefix ONLY as the explicit NEGATIVE polarity marker), mode in {ALL, ANY}, strength in {SUFFICIENT (if/when/provided that), NECESSARY (only/solely), EXACTLY (if and only if)}
node_types.EXCEPTION: fields: literals, mode; a carve-out (unless/except/save when); condition-hood and exception-hood are first-class distinct node types and may never be merged
node_types.ACTOR: fields: atom (actor:x), exclusive (boolean; true when the text says only/alone/reserved for that bearer)
node_types.QUALIFIER: fields: kind in {IDENTITY, PROVENANCE, QUANTIFIER}, value (identity:x | evidence:x | AT_MOST_n)

edge_types.REGULATES: MODALITY -> REGULATED (exactly one per REGULATED node)
edge_types.ACTIVATES: CONDITION -> REGULATED (plain gate; literals keep their own polarity)
edge_types.FOLLOWS: CONDITION -> REGULATED (clause happens AFTER the event atoms; literals positive, temporal compiled AFTER)
edge_types.PRECEDES: CONDITION -> REGULATED (clause happens BEFORE the event atoms; literals compiled negated, temporal BEFORE; all literals must be event: atoms)
edge_types.ACTOR_OF: ACTOR -> REGULATED (actor atom joins that clause's condition literals)
edge_types.QUALIFIES: QUALIFIER kind IDENTITY or QUANTIFIER -> REGULATED
edge_types.SOURCE_OF: QUALIFIER kind PROVENANCE -> REGULATED (evidence atom joins that clause's condition literals; provenance compiled TOOL_RESULT)

representation_freeze.cardinality_rules: per REGULATED node: exactly one REGULATES; at most one ACTIVATES condition; at most one PRECEDES-or-FOLLOWS condition (both present with different modes is invalid; PRECEDES and FOLLOWS together are invalid); at most one EXEMPTS; at most one ACTOR_OF; at most one QUALIFIES per kind; at most one SOURCE_OF. A gate node may bind several REGULATED nodes (shared gates).
representation_freeze.polarity_encoding: literal = optional '!' (NEGATIVE) + catalog atom (POSITIVE); polarity is an explicit syntactic field of the literal, never baked into a free-form atom name

compilation.relation_derivation: REQUIREMENT with exception and no condition -> UNLESS; else EXACTLY strength -> IF_AND_ONLY_IF; else NECESSARY strength or exclusive actor -> ONLY_IF; else any condition node -> IF; else UNCONDITIONAL. PROHIBITION/PERMISSION with exceptions and no condition compile to UNCONDITIONAL + exception literals (behaviorally identical to UNLESS for these modalities; matches the V4/V5/PHV1 gold convention)
compilation.condition_literals: ACTIVATES literals + temporal-condition literals (FOLLOWS positive, PRECEDES '!'-prefixed) + actor atom + identity value + evidence value, sorted, deduplicated; condition_mode from the condition node(s) (must agree when both plain and temporal nodes attach; ALL when no condition node carries literals)
compilation.carried_fields: temporal (BEFORE/AFTER from PRECEDES/FOLLOWS), identity (IDENTITY qualifier value), provenance (TOOL_RESULT when SOURCE_OF attaches), quantification (QUANTIFIER value); actor field stays 'assistant' exactly as in the frozen H0 contract
compilation.together_vs_separate: atoms in one REGULATED node = regulated together (one multi-atom target clause); separate REGULATED nodes = regulated separately (AND_NOT_EACH-style togetherness needs no special relation: it IS clause grouping)

representation_freeze.composed_verdict: VIOLATION if any per-clause program yields VIOLATION, else PERMITTED if any yields PERMITTED, else NO_VIOLATION; a single-program set composes to exactly the v3 verdict (H0 scoring continuity)
representation_freeze.conservative_invariant: NO_VIOLATION is not PERMITTED; absence of prohibition is never positive authorization; an empty graph (text regulates nothing) composes to NO_VIOLATION on every world

permission_gate_freeze.applies_to: every compiled clause program with modality PERMISSION, in arm H2 only
permission_gate_freeze.semantics: if the policy text carries NO frozen positive-permission evidence marker, the PERMISSION clause is REJECTED (dropped from the compiled program set) and recorded as rejected_permission_clause; it is never automatically remapped to another modality; the ungoverned content composes to NO_VIOLATION (UNKNOWN / no explicit permission)

evidence_marker_classes.MAY: the modal 'may', not followed by 'not' within two tokens, and not preceded by a negator (no/nobody/no one/nothing/none/neither/nor/never/cannot) within the current clause segment
evidence_marker_classes.PERMISSIVE_PREDICATE: be-forms (is/are/am/be/been/being/was/were) followed by permitted/allowed/entitled/free/authorised/authorized, optionally 'to', not preceded by a negator within the current clause segment
evidence_marker_classes.PERMISSION_GRANTED: 'permission is granted/given' or 'grants/grant permission', not preceded by a negator within the current clause segment
evidence_marker_classes.AUTHORIZATION_ALLOWS: 'authorisation/authorization/licence/license allows/permits/covers', not preceded by a negator within the current clause segment
evidence_marker_classes.RESERVED_ALLOCATION: 'is/are reserved to/for', not preceded by a negator within the current clause segment
evidence_marker_classes.OPEN_TO: 'it is open to', not preceded by a negator within the current clause segment
evidence_marker_classes.CAN_EXCLUSIVE: 'can' in an exclusivity context ('only ... can' or 'can ... only' within one clause segment) - a bare descriptive 'can' is NOT evidence

permission_gate_freeze.not_evidence: absence of prohibition; absence of requirement; physical possibility; descriptive 'can'/'is able to' without normative force; NO_VIOLATION anywhere
permission_gate_freeze.scope_limitation: detection is text-level by design (frozen, deterministic, class-based); clause-level span attribution is NOT part of this mechanism and is reported as NOT TESTED

metrics.primary: behavioral case correctness: the arm's compiled program set composes a verdict on every frozen world that belongs to the acceptable set (composed verdicts of the admissible gold sets) on every world
metrics.binding_attachment: canonical attachment triples (class, payload, target_atoms): MODALITY (value), CONDITION (literal set, with '!' polarity as compiled), EXCEPTION (literal set), ACTOR (atom), QUALIFIER_IDENTITY/QUALIFIER_PROVENANCE/QUALIFIER_QUANTIFIER (value), CLAUSE (atom set = scope/togetherness). Per class: micro precision, recall, F1 pooled over all cases. Aggregate binding accuracy = micro-F1 pooled over ALL triple classes. H0 graphs are projected canonically from the flat structure (every gate attaches to every target clause = the formal statement of global attachment; actor/identity/evidence literals are split out of condition_literals; quantification from the quantification field; the inert identity/provenance string fields are ignored)

permission_metrics.permission_clause_precision: predicted PERMISSION clauses whose atom set matches a gold PERMISSION clause / all predicted PERMISSION clauses (pre-gate structures for H0/H1; post-gate survivors for H2)
permission_metrics.permission_clause_recall: matched gold PERMISSION clauses / all gold PERMISSION clauses; missed_explicit_permission_rate = 1 - recall
permission_metrics.invented_permission_case_rate: cases where the arm's composed verdict is PERMITTED on some frozen world while NO admissible gold composition yields PERMITTED on that world (PHV1-compatible verdict-level definition; this is the gated quantity)

metrics.multiaxis: full-case behavioral correctness restricted to the multi-axis cohort (all axes correct simultaneously, not field-wise)
metrics.regression: H0 correct -> candidate wrong, per candidate; rate over H0-correct cases
metrics.correction_precision: baseline_wrong->candidate_right / (baseline_wrong->candidate_right + baseline_right->candidate_wrong), reported for H1-vs-H0, H2-vs-H0 and H2-vs-H1
metrics.statistics: exact two-sided McNemar on discordant pairs for H1 vs H0, H2 vs H1, H2 vs H0 with corrections:regressions reported explicitly; Wilson 95% CI per arm; Newcombe paired CI for each delta
metrics.validity: schema/compile validity per arm (parse ok or ok_repaired over 44); informational floor 0.90 - below it the run is an INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE, not a scientific result

decisions.PROMOTE_TO_NEW_HOLDOUT: H1 supported AND H2 supported AND primary candidate gate passes (H2 >= H0 + 15 pp)
decisions.REJECT_STRUCTURAL_BINDING_HYPOTHESIS: H1 gates fail (relation binding is not the dominant generalization cause, or explicit attachment does not fix it)
decisions.REJECT_PERMISSION_GATE_HYPOTHESIS: H1 supported but H2 gates fail
decisions.HYPOTHESES_SUPPORTED_CANDIDATE_NOT_PROMO: H1 and H2 supported but H2 < H0 + 15 pp: no new holdout, STOP standalone Policy research, integrate with the documented best-available frontend
decisions.REJECT_BOTH: H1 and H2 both fail: STOP standalone Policy research, integrate with documented Policy limitation
decisions.overclaim_rule: even on a full causal pass the only permitted verdict is PROMOTE_TO_NEW_HOLDOUT; 'Policy solved' may never be claimed

final_holdout_conditional.candidate: PSB-H2 frozen exactly as run in the causal experiment (prompt, schema, compiler, gate, model, retry); any change makes it a different candidate and is forbidden
final_holdout_conditional.freshness: zero shared word 8-grams with every V4, V5, PHV1 and causal-benchmark policy text; fresh domains; confirmatory cases never drawn from any development corpus

outcomes.PROMOTE_TO_INTEGRATION: all final gates pass: STOP standalone Policy research; Policy + Goal + Binder + Evidence + Temporal/Effects + Core proceed to composition/E2E
outcomes.POLICY_LIMITATION_CONFIRMED: any final gate fails: NO further architecture generation; fix 'Policy semantic frontend remains imperfect' and proceed anyway to controlled integration/E2E, where the end-to-end effect of the parser error rate (after abstention, UNKNOWN, certificates, independent witnesses) is measured systematically

discipline.smoke: before the first semantic request: one synthetic non-benchmark case through the H0 schema AND one through the PSB schema (transport + schema path only)
discipline.seal: per arm, before any gold join: prediction_sha256, case_ids_sha256, gold_joined=false
discipline.parse_policy: exactly one parse per case per arm schema (+ at most one machine-validation-triggered repair re-ask: transport failure, schema invalid or compile failure - never for schema-valid wrong answers); no judge, no critic, no ensemble, no self-consistency
discipline.transport: client max_retries=0 (no invisible retries); abandoned request captures are never resent; quota stops per CONFIG
discipline.during_inference: only transport/schema/status facts are inspected; semantic inspection begins only after seal + score
discipline.inference_logging: per-case persisted requests with full payload/telemetry, resumable, byte-stable on rerun
discipline.historical_separation: Arm C ~78.1% (user-reported, absence-attested), H0-V5 95.77% (machine-verified controlled), PHV1 73.75% (machine-verified prospective) and this cycle's numbers are reported as separate implementation/distribution results, never as one learning curve
